defects: Severe horizontal overflow on mobile (390px) clips the header subtitle, the right side of the roast curve and dark telemetry values, the right-column KPI cards, green inventory status labels, and the rightmost columns of both tables.

In desktop-full, the sidebar user footer ('Mara Okafor') is positioned at the 900px viewport height rather than the bottom of the full-height sidebar, leaving a large empty dark-green region below it.
V3.note: Rich, domain-authentic desktop roastery command center with an expressive live roast curve and Agtron swatches, but held back by widespread horizontal clipping at 390px.

defects: On mobile (390px), the bottom two-column grid ('Today's roast batches' and 'Wholesale orders') fails to stack into a single column, crushing each table into a narrow ~175px column and clipping most of their data.
On mobile (390px), the 'Green bean inventory' table overflows its card and clips the entire 'Status' column on the right.
On mobile (390px), the top horizontal navigation bar clips links past 'Green beans'.
In desktop-full, the sidebar user block ('Mira Kovac') floats mid-sidebar at 900px with blank space beneath it.
Q5.note: Warm, well-organized desktop dashboard with a clear reorder warning banner, but the uncollapsed two-column bottom grid makes the mobile layout unusable.

defects: On mobile (390px), the rightmost 'Roasted kg' column in the 'Wholesale orders' table is clipped at the right edge.
On mobile (390px), the internal text annotations inside the scaled-down SVG roast curve become very small.
In desktop-full, the sidebar's bottom machine-maintenance note sits around the 900px fold line with empty sidebar space below it.
H8.note: Exceptional editorial craft and deep roastery domain fit that pairs live drum telemetry and today's batch queue with stock cover and order fulfillment across both desktop and mobile.

defects: On mobile (390px), the 'Today's roast schedule' table overflows horizontally inside its card, clipping 'Green' and cutting off the 'Roasted', 'Loss', and 'Status' columns.
On mobile (390px), the 'Wholesale orders' table overflows horizontally inside its card, clipping 'Contents' and cutting off the 'Weight', 'Due', 'Status', and 'Value' columns.
On mobile (390px), the top navigation bar clips items from 'Green inventory' onward.
In desktop-full, the sidebar user profile ('Mara Okonkwo') sits at 900px with empty sidebar space below it.
F2.note: Warm, cohesive roastery dashboard with strong hierarchy and actionable alerts on desktop, though its wide data tables clip heavily on mobile.

defects: On desktop, the 'Roasted output' 14-day bar chart stretches vertically to match the tall 'Green coffee' card beside it, leaving overly elongated bars.
In desktop-full, the white sidebar background and footer stop at 900px, leaving an empty gray column beneath the sidebar.
Includes a fourth-wall-breaking disclaimer footer ('Sample data for layout review. Figures are not live.').
X7.note: Clean, practical roastery operations dashboard with well-structured inventory cover and the best mobile table adaptation in the set.

defects: On mobile (390px), 'Green bean stock' and 'Wholesale orders' overflow past the right viewport edge, cutting off the days-of-cover numbers, filter pills, and the entire 'Value' column.
On mobile (390px), all top navigation links disappear with no menu button provided.
On desktop, the SVG roast curve has an unnatural sharp kink at minute 5 and its '-- Profile target' dashed line is barely visible.
The page subtitle states '5 batches roasted today, 2 more scheduled', but the 'Today's batches' list only shows the 5 completed batches.
N6.note: Tasteful sage-and-espresso editorial styling on desktop, but severely compromised on mobile by missing navigation and right-edge overflow on the bottom cards.

defects: On desktop, the 'Roasted output, last 30 days' card has a large empty whitespace gap below the chart due to the taller adjacent 'Green bean stock' card.
On mobile (390px), top navigation links disappear completely with no menu toggle.
On mobile (390px), both bottom tables squeeze all columns into 390px, causing awkward narrow text wrapping ('B-\n4821') and clipping the rightmost 'Status' column ('QC p', '✓ Ready to sh').
M5.note: A competent but generic royal-blue SaaS template that lacks coffee-specific character, interactive workflow controls, and responsive mobile table handling.

defects: On mobile (390px), the stock gauge bars in 'Green bean inventory' are crushed into unreadable ~15px wide slivers.
On mobile (390px), 'Wholesale orders' cuts off the 'Due' and 'Status' columns, and 'Recent roast batches' cuts off 'Green kg', 'Roasted kg', 'Loss', 'Roaster', and 'Cupping'.
On mobile (390px), top navigation links disappear completely with no menu button.
On desktop, 'Recent roast batches' is pushed entirely below the 900px fold, and the 'Wholesale orders' card has a large blank gap at the bottom.
U7.note: Generic SaaS card template with jarring primary blue/orange/green roast-level colors, poor above-the-fold balance, and crushed gauges and clipped tables on mobile.

defects: On mobile (390px), every card below the KPIs ('Roasted output' chart, 'Green bean inventory', 'Recent roast batches', and 'Wholesale orders') overflows horizontally off the right edge of the viewport.
On desktop, the 'Roasted output' card has a large empty whitespace gap beneath the chart, and both 'Recent roast batches' and 'Wholesale orders' sit almost entirely below the 900px fold.
Missing application navigation on both desktop and mobile (only a 'Toggle theme' button and date-range tabs are shown).
A8.note: Reads like a generic 30-day BI report rather than a live roastery tool, lacks app navigation, and suffers from horizontal overflow across every major section on mobile.
